newsitem.title: USA: MK Rail names William Fabrizio CFO.
newsitem.headline: MK Rail names William Fabrizio CFO.

text.p: MK Rail Corp said Thursday it named William Fabrizio senior vice president and chief financial officer, effective Nov. 18.
Fabrizio, 48, succeeds James F. Cleary Jr., who resigned in May to pursue other opportunities.
A Pittsburgh native, Fabrizio has 23 years of experience in finance and accounting, a statement from MK said, including 17 years with Rockwell International Corporation.
He is currently the chief financial officer of the Automotive Industries Division of Lear Corporation, the statement said.

In 1995, Fabrizio joined Automotive Industries Holdings, Inc., an $800 million manufacturer of automotive interior systems, as chief financial officer. In August 1995, the company was bought by Lear, and Fabrizio assumed his current position, the statement said.
